sources.name: OS Maps API Overview
sources.role: raster basemap, projection, update and portrayal-role contract
verified_facts: OS Maps API serves pre-rendered raster tiles, supports WMTS and ZXY, and offers British National Grid and Web Mercator projections.
semantic_limits: A rendered basemap is portrayal output and must not be used as a numeric terrain coverage or parcel elevation source.

sources.name: OS Maps API Technical Specification
sources.role: WMTS and ZXY interface discovery contract
verified_facts: The technical specification exposes OS Maps API through WMTS and ZXY access methods.
semantic_limits: Interface documentation does not prove that a particular tile was fetched, complete, current or suitable for measurement.

sources.name: OS Maps API ZXY Endpoint
sources.role: raster tile path, layer, zoom and coordinate contract
verified_facts: The ZXY endpoint addresses PNG tiles by layer, zoom, x and y values.
semantic_limits: A successful PNG response is a visual tile and does not establish native raster values, parcel containment or height accuracy.

sources.name: OS Maps API WMTS Endpoint
sources.role: WMTS matrix-set, matrix, row, column and style contract
verified_facts: The WMTS endpoint binds requests to a layer, tile matrix set, tile matrix, tile row and tile column.
semantic_limits: Tile matrix addressing identifies a portrayal fragment, not an exact HMLR polygon or a DEM sample receipt.

sources.name: OS Vector Tile API Overview
sources.role: vector basemap, projection, styling and attribution-scope contract
verified_facts: OS Vector Tile API provides customisable vector tiles in British National Grid and Web Mercator projections.
semantic_limits: Vector tiles contain selected attribution and must not be treated as the full authoritative product or numeric terrain evidence.

sources.name: OS Vector Tile API Technical Specification
sources.role: PBF encoding, service metadata, stylesheet and tile endpoint contract
verified_facts: The service provides Protocolbuffer Binary Format tiles and separate service-metadata, stylesheet and tile endpoints.
semantic_limits: Metadata or stylesheet success does not prove tile completeness, source version, geometry authority or elevation semantics.

sources.name: OS Vector Tile API Tile Request
sources.role: z/y/x tile path, overlay and response-CRS contract
verified_facts: The tile endpoint returns binary PBF data addressed by z, y and x, with supported SRS values including 27700 and 3857.
semantic_limits: One tile or overlay response is not proof that all intersecting source features were retrieved or measured.

sources.name: OS Vector Tile API Data Availability
sources.role: selected feature attribution and product-cross-reference contract
verified_facts: The vector-tile service exposes selected attributes and identifiers for visualisation and cross-reference.
semantic_limits: A displayed attribute such as building relative height is not bare-earth terrain height and must not replace EA DTM sampling.

sources.name: OS Linked Identifiers API Overview
sources.role: cross-product identifier relationship contract
verified_facts: The API links identifiers such as UPRN, USRN and TOID across property, street and OS feature datasets.
semantic_limits: The API does not return geometry or full feature attribution; identifier linkage is not cadastral polygon evidence.

sources.name: OS Linked Identifiers API Technical Specification
sources.role: identifier, identifier-type, feature-type and product-version endpoint contract
verified_facts: The technical specification defines four principal endpoint families for identifier relationships and version information.
semantic_limits: Endpoint availability does not prove relationship completeness, geometry identity or measurement correctness.

sources.name: OS Linked Identifiers Identifier Endpoint
sources.role: identifier lookup and namespace-overlap contract
verified_facts: The identifier endpoint returns associated IDs and can return multiple link sets because identifier namespaces can overlap.
semantic_limits: An identifier string must not be accepted without identifier type, version and relationship context.

sources.name: OS Linked Identifiers Identifier Types Endpoint
sources.role: typed GUID, TOID, UPRN and USRN relationship contract
verified_facts: The endpoint accepts a known identifier type and returns linked identifiers with correlation metadata.
semantic_limits: Relationship confidence metadata is not parcel-height confidence and cannot create a numeric business result.

sources.name: OS Names API Overview
sources.role: named-place discovery, ambiguity and contextual-location contract
verified_facts: OS Names API is a geographic directory for named-place discovery; place names are not necessarily unique.
semantic_limits: A place-name match is not a parcel identifier, exact polygon or authoritative terrain measurement location.

sources.name: OS Names API Technical Specification
sources.role: Find and Nearest resource plus JSON/XML response contract
verified_facts: The service exposes Find and Nearest resources and can return JSON or XML.
semantic_limits: Directory response syntax does not prove spatial containment, cadastral identity or elevation semantics.

sources.name: OS Names API Find Endpoint
sources.role: free-text fuzzy query, paging and maximum-result contract
verified_facts: The Find endpoint performs an ambiguous or fuzzy free-text search with maximum-result and offset controls.
semantic_limits: A fuzzy or paged search result must not be promoted to an exact target row without independent identifier and geometry binding.

sources.name: OS Names API Nearest Endpoint
sources.role: British National Grid point and radius nearest-feature contract
verified_facts: The Nearest endpoint finds named features closest to a British National Grid point within an optional radius.
semantic_limits: Nearest-feature selection is not point-in-polygon containment and cannot replace exact HMLR matching.

sources.name: OS API Authentication
sources.role: OAuth2, header-key and query-key authentication contract
verified_facts: OS APIs support OAuth2 bearer tokens, an HTTP key header or a key query parameter.
semantic_limits: Authentication proves access authorization only; it does not validate source authority, payload completeness or measurement truth.

sources.name: OS API Error Codes
sources.role: HTTP success, cache, client-error, rate-limit and service-error contract
verified_facts: OS documents 2xx success, 304 cache reuse, 4xx client errors, 429 rate limiting and 5xx service errors.
semantic_limits: HTTP status alone must not be treated as a complete-download, digest, geometry or numeric-measurement receipt.

sources.name: OS API Rate-Limiting Policy
sources.role: per-project and per-API request-rate contract
verified_facts: OS documents different transaction-per-minute limits for live and development projects and uses 429 after exceeding the limit.
semantic_limits: Retry handling must be idempotent and must not duplicate candidate or business writes.

sources.name: OS API Project Setup
sources.role: project-scoped API credential and API-enablement contract
verified_facts: API access requires adding an API to an OS Data Hub project and generating project credentials.
semantic_limits: Credential scope does not pin a data-product version, response bytes or measurement provenance.

sources.name: RFC 6901 — JSON Pointer
sources.role: JSON member-path and escaping contract
verified_facts: JSON Pointer identifies a value through slash-prefixed reference tokens and defines ~0 and ~1 escaping.
semantic_limits: A syntactically valid pointer does not prove that the selected value is present, current, authoritative or correctly typed.

sources.name: RFC 6902 — JSON Patch
sources.role: ordered partial-update operation and atomic-failure contract
verified_facts: JSON Patch represents an ordered array of add, remove, replace, move, copy and test operations.
semantic_limits: Patch success does not prove source provenance; the exact base document version and post-update digest must remain bound.

sources.name: RFC 7396 — JSON Merge Patch
sources.role: object merge, null-removal and whole-array replacement contract
verified_facts: JSON Merge Patch uses object-shaped changes, interprets null as removal and replaces non-object targets as a whole.
semantic_limits: Null in a merge patch is a deletion instruction and must not be interpreted as an observed zero or missing-height measurement.

sources.name: RFC 7464 — JSON Text Sequences
sources.role: record-separator, line-feed and incremental-stream contract
verified_facts: JSON text sequences use UTF-8 JSON values framed by an ASCII record separator and line feed for incremental processing.
semantic_limits: Sequence framing and parser recovery do not prove that every expected record arrived or that the stream is an authoritative source.

sources.name: RFC 8949 — Concise Binary Object Representation
sources.role: CBOR binary data-model and deterministic-encoding profile contract
verified_facts: CBOR is a compact extensible binary representation designed for small code and message sizes.
semantic_limits: Valid CBOR decoding does not prove application semantics, unique map keys, deterministic bytes or measurement truth.

sources.name: RFC 9052 — COSE Structures and Process
sources.role: CBOR signature, MAC, encryption and key-representation contract
verified_facts: COSE defines signature, message-authentication and encryption structures serialized with CBOR.
semantic_limits: Cryptographic verification covers the configured COSE inputs; it does not prove the scientific or cadastral truth of a payload.

sources.name: RFC 3986 — URI Generic Syntax
sources.role: scheme, authority, path, query, fragment and reference-resolution contract
verified_facts: RFC 3986 defines generic URI syntax and separates resource identification from resource interaction.
semantic_limits: URI equality, normalization or successful resolution does not prove immutable source bytes or publication identity.

sources.name: RFC 3987 — Internationalized Resource Identifiers
sources.role: Unicode IRI and deterministic IRI-to-URI mapping contract
verified_facts: RFC 3987 defines Unicode IRIs and a mapping from IRIs to URIs.
semantic_limits: Display equivalence or successful mapping does not establish source identity; normalization and encoding must remain explicit.
